answer:
Honest side: an agent locks 150 units for 20 epochs, unlocking 5% each honest epoch, drawing yield like nectar.

Forgery side: the same 150 lock just as long, but forgery slashes 60% and resets the timer, so frozen capital earns nothing and cannot rotate.

The ledgers diverge: 1,000 fakes lock 150,000 units; at 30% detection one round burns 27,000. Honest patience is a sonnet; the forger's lotus never blooms, it pays rent on dead money.
